meta.titre: Software Categories: system, application and utility programs sorted

source.epreuve_titre: GCE O/L Computer Science past paper (Cameroon)

sections.contenu_markdown: In a school computer room in Bamenda, the technician installs an operating system, an antivirus, a word processor and a program that keeps the school fees records. All of them are called software, but they do very different jobs. The GCE often gives a program name and asks you to place it in the right category, or gives a job and asks for the type of program that does it. A clear classification table settles most of these questions.

items: Hardware is the physical part of a computer and software is the set of programs that runs on it.
A program is a list of instructions that the computer follows.
A file is a named collection of data stored on a disk.

sections.contenu_markdown:
### Two main categories

**System software** controls and looks after the computer itself. **Application software** lets the user do a task such as writing, calculating or drawing.

### System software

* **Operating system (OS)**: manages the hardware and the other programs, for example Windows, Linux or Android.
* **Utility programs**: maintenance tools such as an antivirus, a disk defragmenter, a backup tool or a file compression tool.
* **Language translators**: change a program into machine code. A compiler translates the whole program at once, an interpreter translates and runs it line by line, and an assembler translates assembly language.
* **Device drivers**: let the OS communicate with a device such as a printer.

### Application software

| Type | Purpose | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Word processor | Create and format documents | Word, Writer |
| Spreadsheet | Calculations on rows and columns | Excel, Calc |
| Database management system (DBMS) | Store and organise data in a database | Access, MySQL |
| Presentation | Slide shows | PowerPoint, Impress |
| Graphics | Draw and edit pictures | Paint, GIMP |
| Web browser | Display web pages | Chrome, Firefox |
| Text editor | Create and edit plain text files | Notepad |

A **text editor** saves plain characters only, with no pictures and no layout. This is why it is also used for program code and for HTML.

### Ready-made or tailor-made

**General-purpose software** (off-the-shelf) is bought ready-made and does many common jobs. **Custom-written (bespoke) software** is made for one organisation's special need, such as a school fees or payroll system.

variantes.quand_utiliser: When a program name is given and you must classify it.
variantes.contenu_markdown: Ask: does this program serve the **computer** (system software) or does it help the **user do a task** (application software)? Drivers, the OS, translators and antivirus serve the computer. A DBMS, a browser or a spreadsheet serve a user task, so they are application software.

variantes.quand_utiliser: When asked which program shows no pictures.
variantes.contenu_markdown: A plain **text editor** or a command-line screen shows characters only. Word processors, graphics programs, presentation programs and browsers can all display pictures.

sections.enonce_markdown: A clerk at a small clinic uses these programs: Linux, a spreadsheet, an antivirus, a printer driver, a program written only for the clinic's patient records, and Notepad. Classify each as system or application software and give a further type.

etapes.justification: System software serves the machine; application software serves the user's task.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Linux, antivirus and printer driver serve the machine. The other three serve a user task.

etapes.justification: Each system program has a defined role.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Linux: operating system. Antivirus: utility. Printer driver: device driver.

etapes.justification: General-purpose programs do common jobs; a program made for one organisation is custom-written.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Spreadsheet: general-purpose application. Patient records program: custom-written application. Notepad: text editor.

etapes.justification: A program that edits plain text for the user is an application, not a utility.

sections.conclusion_markdown: **System software: Linux (operating system), antivirus (utility), printer driver (device driver). Application software: spreadsheet (general-purpose), patient records program (custom-written), Notepad (text editor).**

items.erreur_markdown: "A DBMS is system software because it manages data."
items.pourquoi_faux: A DBMS helps the user store and organise data for a task, so it is application software. Only the operating system manages the hardware.
A compiler translates programs into machine code for the computer. It serves the machine, so it is system software (a language translator).

items.erreur_markdown: "A text editor and a word processor are the same program."
items.pourquoi_faux: A word processor adds fonts, layout and pictures; a text editor saves plain characters only.
items.correction_markdown: Use a text editor for plain text or code, and a word processor for formatted documents.

items.erreur_markdown: "Hardware means programs and software means the machines."
items.correction_markdown: Hardware is the physical parts; software is the programs.

items.enonce_markdown: Classify each as system or application software: (a) a web browser, (b) an operating system, (c) a spreadsheet.
Explain the difference between general-purpose software and custom-written software, with one example of each for a school.
items.solution_markdown: General-purpose software is bought ready-made and does common jobs for many users, for example a word processor for typing reports. Custom-written software is made for one organisation's special need, for example a program built only to record the fees and results of that school. **Ready-made means for many users; custom-written means for one organisation.**

items.enonce_markdown: A new computer lab opens in a secondary school. Name four programs that should be installed, say whether each is system or application software, and justify each choice in one line.
items.solution_markdown: Award marks for any four justified choices, for example: operating system (system software): it manages the hardware and runs the other programs. Antivirus (utility, so system software): it protects the machines and files from malware. Word processor (application): pupils type and format documents. Spreadsheet (application): pupils learn calculations on tables. Other accepted: browser, DBMS, device drivers, a language translator for programming lessons. **Each choice needs its category and its reason.**

items_markdown: System software looks after the computer; application software helps the user perform a task.
System software includes the operating system, utility programs, language translators and device drivers.
A DBMS, a spreadsheet, a browser and a word processor are application software.
A text editor creates and modifies plain text files and shows no pictures.
General-purpose software is ready-made; custom-written software is built for one organisation.
